notes.title: Grab a free Steam key for stunning, atmospheric puzzler Particle Hearts
notes.notes:
When I think of the best puzzle games, a striking art style goes a long way. Return of the Obra Dinn, The Witness, Antichamber, The Swapper - even the likes of Outer Wilds. It's not a must-have, but it can turn a great experience into a truly memorable one. Particle Hearts has got the goods. This gorgeous blend of contemplation, intrigue, and exploration takes place in "a world made entirely of particles," which you must manipulate in order to proceed. If it's slipped under your radar, we've got good news in the form of dozens of free Steam keys that we're giving away.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: PARTICLE HEARTS IS STEAM DECK VERIFIED!
notes.notes:
Great news, Drifters! 

Particle Hearts is now officially Steam Deck verified! 

Something we always loved from our testing was how great Particle Hearts performs on Steam Deck, and how much those beautiful particle colors pop, especially on OLED. 

It sure is great to get that green check mark and make it official, so we wanted to shout about it. 

Enjoy Particle Hearts on the go, and unravel the mysteries of this strange and beautiful land of particles from anywhere. 

- The First Break Labs team

notes.title: NEW TRAILER!
notes.notes:
We are excited to share with you a new trailer revealing some never-seen-before footage of cutscenes and gameplay, all rendered and captured from within the game engine. The trailer showcases some of the locations, denizens, and puzzles you will encounter in a mysterious world made entirely from particles, the beautiful world of Particle Hearts.

Please have a look and let us know what you think in the comments! Stay tuned, we'll have more news and information about Particle Hearts in the weeks ahead.
